verification_policy: Single-skill research: verify canonical identity, race restriction, acquisition, cost, and mechanics; preserve unresolved fields as null.
research_scope: Namek Finger — Strike Super / Namekian skill research.

verification_audit.method: Compared current Xenoverse 2-specific skill documentation with independent Dragon Ball documentation and repository research coverage.

duplicate_check.identity_note: No existing repository research commit for Namek Finger was found. Canonical identity is Super / Strike; Namekian Skills is a cross-taxonomy characteristic.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Xenoverse 2 documentation classifies Namek Finger as a Strike Super and Namekian-exclusive skill.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 documentation lists the Skill Shop as the unlock route.
verification_audit.finish_policy: ultimate_finish_required remains null because the documented route is Skill Shop rather than a Parallel Quest reward.

records.name: Namek Finger
records.character_source: Nail / Lord Slug / Piccolo customizable partner / Namekian CaCs
records.skill_description: Extend the arm to grab an opponent at long range, pull them toward the user, and strike them, leaving them stunned for follow-up attacks.
records.mechanics_notes: The move is a long-range, single-hit, paralyzing grab-style Strike Super. It is also documented as unblockable. For Orange Piccolo the animation is repurposed as his grab rather than a CaC skill.
records.acquisition_notes: Current Xenoverse 2-specific documentation lists Skill Shop. Independent documentation confirms the move is usable by a Namekian Future Warrior and is exclusive to Namekians.
records.pve_notes: Skill Shop acquisition; no Parallel Quest or Ultimate Finish requirement established.
records.pvp_notes: Long-range grab and stun/restand behavior can enable follow-ups; exact frame and matchup interactions are not promoted to canonical numeric data.
